page_title: VLL 1-1 PAL | Valladolid v Las Palmas 28/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
90+7' Valladolid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+6' Valladolid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+3' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' It's unbelievable, Mario Martin (Valladolid) blows a huge opportunity! He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific daisy-cutter from point blank range. His first-time effort is directed towards the middle of the target, but Jasper Cillessen reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
86' Adam Aznou (Valladolid) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
86' Mario Martin (Valladolid) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
85' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Jose Campana is replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
84' The corner is swung in but Valladolid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marcos Andre as he is replaced by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid).
80' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valladolid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' A substitution has been made. Sandro Ramirez is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
79' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Raul Moro (Valladolid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Jasper Cillessen easily deals with the threat. Valladolid earn a corner.
78' Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
77' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Valladolid.
77' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
76' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it's a whisker wide of the left post.
74' Mario Martin (Valladolid) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
73' Raul Moro (Valladolid) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Jasper Cillessen scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
72' The ball is out of play. Valladolid will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Today's referee Ricardo De Burgos rightly decides to book Mario Martin (Valladolid) for his harsh tackle.
67' Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
66' Valladolid win a corner.

66' Raul Moro (Valladolid) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the roof of the net. It's a great effort but an even better save from Jasper Cillessen, who tips the ball over the bar.
66' Valladolid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
65' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Ricardo De Burgos signals that the goal stands! The Valladolid players celebrate.
64' Celebrations by Valladolid are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
63' 1 - 1 Goal! Marcos Andre gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:1.
63' The linesman points to the corner flag, Valladolid are going to take it.
60' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
58' Substitution. Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) in, Selim Amallah out.
58' The substitution is prepared. Mario Martin (Valladolid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tamas Nikitscher.
58' Alvaro Rubio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luis Perez (Valladolid) replacing Antonio Candela.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anuar departs the field of play to be replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
55' The attendance for today's match is 15643.
53' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
50' A yellow card for a tackle by Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid). Ricardo De Burgos doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' Diego Martinez makes a switch. Stefan Bajcetic is coming on in place of Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) at the start of the second period.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is replaced by Fabio Silva.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
45+6' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) for a tough tackle.
45+4' The linesman raises his flag. Marcos Andre (Valladolid) is adjudged offside.
45+4' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Anuar (Valladolid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Anuar (Valladolid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
44' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
42' Antonio Candela (Valladolid) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
41' Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
41' One of the Las Palmas players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick is awarded to Valladolid.
40' Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
39' Valladolid take a short corner kick.

39' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Jasper Cillessen!
38' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Karl Hein makes a comfortable save.
36' The Valladolid players are exchanging some short passes.
32' The referee signals a substitution. Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Oliver McBurnie.
32' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) strikes the ball on goal from the resulting free kick, but his effort goes wide.
29' We have witnessed a sending-off! Scott McKenna (Las Palmas) is given a red card for his dangerous challenge. Ricardo De Burgos's decision is final.

26' Anuar (Valladolid) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Jasper Cillessen pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
25' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
22' 0 - 1 Goal! Oliver McBurnie passes the ball to Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Karl Hein couldn't do anything about it. 0:1.
22' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

21' Viti (Las Palmas) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Karl Hein makes a brilliant save! Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Las Palmas take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
17' Las Palmas restart play with a quick free kick.
16' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Las Palmas, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
13' Antonio Candela (Valladolid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
9' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Karl Hein comes off his line to intercept.
3' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
1' The match has just started.
Las Palmas will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Ricardo De Burgos.
